_source.title: 获取区域内所有图元
_source.remarks.text.0: 本接口仅会返回完全包含在区域内的图元，如果图元有部分位于区域外，将被忽略
_source.params.left: 矩形框第一 X 坐标
_source.params.right: 矩形框第二 X 坐标
_source.params.top: 矩形框第一 Y 坐标
_source.params.bottom: 矩形框第二 Y 坐标

title: Get All primitives in the region
remarks.text.0: This API only returns primitives that are completely contained in the region. If a primitive is partially outside the region, it will be ignored
params.left: First X coordinate of the rectangle
params.right: Second X coordinate of the rectangle
params.top: First Y coordinate of the rectangle
params.bottom: Second Y coordinate of the rectangle
